Container.Name: GG Requestz
Container.Overview: Discover games, manage requests, and connect your game library. Requires a reachable PostgreSQL database and IGDB credentials. Redis is optional.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Unraid port for the GG Requestz web interface.

Config.Name: Application Origin
Config.Description: Browser URL, including scheme and non-default port. Enter the same value in Public Site URL.

Config.Name: Public Site URL
Config.Description: Browser URL GG Requestz uses for external links.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: Host or container name reachable from this container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: Port reachable at the PostgreSQL host.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Create this database and grant its owner migration access before first start.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL User
Config.Description: Database role used by GG Requestz.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: Password for the GG Requestz database role.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Generate a new value with openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it across upgrades.

Config.Name: IGDB Client ID
Config.Description: Client ID from the Twitch developer console.

Config.Name: IGDB Client Secret
Config.Description: Client secret from the Twitch developer console.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Optional Redis URL reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Authentication Method
Config.Description: Basic opens the first-run administrator setup. See the setup guide for OIDC.

Config.Name: App Workers
Config.Description: A single worker suits smaller servers. Set up Redis before scaling workers.

Config.Name: Automatic Migrations
Config.Description: Initialize and upgrade the configured database at startup.
